text:
maria.gomez: Heads-up — EU embeddings degradation still impacting requests. Product asked marketing to own customer-facing update and coordinate a webinar hold/QA session for impacted accounts. Need statuspage copy + timing. Who can draft?

samir.khan: I can take first stab. Suggest we do an initial statuspage + short email to affected customers in 30m, then a webinar for enterprise customers in 24-48h. Need list of impacted customers from Support.

ellie: +1. Draft statuspage blurb below — can someone check legal/optics?

ellie: ```
Incident: Degraded embeddings in eu-west-1
Status: Investigating
Impact: Some embedding requests are slower or returning errors for a subset of requests for customers in eu-west-1. Engineers are actively working on mitigation; no evidence of customer data compromise at this time.
Workaround: Retry requests or route to eu-central if configured.
Next update: We will post an update in 30 minutes and follow up with a customer webinar for high-volume customers.
```

maria.gomez: Nice. Let's soften 'failing' to 'errors for a subset of requests' and add contact info. Also add link to experimental reroute docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/reroute

tim.bradley: For the webinar gating — product wants only customers with >1000 embeddings/day in last month. Support, can you produce that list and include account owner + AE? @support_jude

support_jude: On it. I'll export a CSV and drop in #support-ops in 15m. Also will append recommended outreach priority: 'critical' then 'high'.

ops-bot: Incident 2113578910 created by monitoring — severity: degraded embeddings; affected region: eu-west-1. Link: https://incidents.redwood.ai/2113578910

samir.khan: For email copy, draft short subject: "Status update: embeddings performance in EU". Body should link to statuspage and include scheduled webinar signup for impacted customers.

ellie: I'll draft the email and landing page for webinar. Can we offer two slots (24h and 48h)? That makes sense for EMEA/US.

maria.gomez: Timing decision: publish initial statuspage + targeted email in 30m. Webinar registration open in 3h, invites to priority accounts first. Marketing ops, can you set lead routing rule to route webinar signups from 'incident-embeddings-eu' to AE queue 'EMEA-Prod' and tag source=incident-embeddings? 

tim.bradley: Will do. I'll also add an internal calendar invite template for AEs to follow up after webinar.

support_jude: CSV posted: https://files.redwood.ai/support/2113578910_impacted.csv

ellie: Drafts completed — dropping links here: statuspage draft: https://docs.google.com/status-draft, email copy: https://docs.google.com/email-draft, webinar landing: https://hub.redwood.ai/webinar/embeddings-incident

samir.khan: Quick QA on status copy before publish: change "no data loss" to "no customer data compromised"? Legal prefers "no evidence of data compromise" — can we use that? @maria.gomez

maria.gomez: Use legal language: "No evidence of customer data compromise at this time." Thanks.

tim.bradley: Marketing ops rule created: route=EMEA-Prod, tag=incident-embeddings, priority=manual-review when impact > 1000/day. :white_check_mark:

maria.gomez: Great. Plan: publish statuspage + targeted email at 2113579130 (30m from now), open webinar registration at 3h, send invites to priority accounts immediately after signup opens. Post-mortem comms to be coordinated with eng post-resolution. Thanks all. :pray:

ellie: Publishing scheduled. Will ping when live. :rocket:
